The first draft initiated by eng. Tarek Ebrahim Hassan, tested by eng. Wael 
Ahmed, revised by MDEPC quality control eng: Adel Abdel Qader Al- Nagar, 
accepted by eng. Mostafa EL-Qlmoshy: general director, approved by eng. Mahmoud 
Sakr: head Sector of Talkha Power station, certified by eng. Samir Abdel Gilel: MDEPC inspection and quality 
control general director & MPIS coordinator, and approved by eng. Mohamed Nageb: 
MDEPC inspection &quality control head Sector.

The maintenance staff should be trained, qualified, and carry the suitable 
 ID safety category.
مطلوب سياج أمان مع علامات تحذيرية تحيط بمنطقة العمل.
Personal protective equipment must be used as safety shoes, and safety helmet.
The unit must be out of service.
